build_CroCoNet: build a CroCoNet model with configurable encoder depth, decoder depth, and positional embedding type
run_CroCoNet_forward: run the CroCoNet forward pass on two image tensors to get masked image predictions
create_CroCoNet_patchify: create patchified tokens from an image tensor by splitting into non-overlapping patches
create_CroCoNet_unpatchify: create an image tensor from patchified tokens by reconstructing the original spatial layout
review_CroCoNet_encoder_decoder: review the CroCoNet encoder and decoder architecture with configurable transformer blocks and mask generation
